numberPrefix.hint: Start of the numbers given to new devices (555- by default, NC- in Cyberpunk): 555-0123. Numbers ending in 02xx (555-0200 to 555-0299) are never given out: keep them for the NPC directory.

universe.hint: Era or genre of the game: sets the devices offered for new devices, their default looks, the phone created for a character who has none (a mobile in Vintage, a smartphone otherwise) and some words. Existing devices do not change.

gmLook.hint: Look of the GM panel. Auto: follows the universe (Orange haze in Cyberpunk, Classic in Vintage, Ops room otherwise).

Welcome.Title: Welcome to Phones & Computers
Welcome.PointDevice: To be called or texted, a player's character only needs a device. Give one from the Send tab of the panel, in one click.
Welcome.PointNpc: From the {panel} panel, call or write under any name or number you like. No need to create NPC devices or fill in the directory.
Welcome.PointReply: Players can call or text any number, even a made-up one that is not in the directory: you answer, as whoever you like.
Welcome.NoCharacters: No player has an assigned character. Assign a character to each player (User Configuration), then reopen this window.
Welcome.Reopen: To reopen this window: ? button in the {panel} panel.

Welcome.Mail:
Welcome to {operator}
Your mailbox {number} is active. Your messages will arrive here.
Welcome.ReadyBare: {n} PC(s) without a device: give one from the Send tab
Welcome.PointDirectory: The Directory is optional: no number to create, no NPC to set up. It only helps you keep track (name a number, make it public, pin it, switch it off), and fills up as you play.
Welcome.MoreTools: More tools: secure devices, jammer, tracking…
Welcome.UniverseHint: Devices offered and their default looks. Changing it reloads the game; existing devices do not change.

Tour.Title: Phones & Computers: the GM panel
Tour.Description: Call and text players as any NPC.

send.title: Send
send.content: Everything starts here: messages and calls to the players.

recipient.title: Recipient
recipient.content: Pick a PC, then one of their devices; or a place where PCs are, and its landline. A PC without a device gets one here in one click.

sender.title: Sender
sender.content: Type the name or number the players will see: an NPC, a made-up number… No NPC device or directory needed. Left empty, the number is hidden.

mode.title: Message or call
mode.content: Send a message, or ring their device. When they answer, play the NPC out loud.

inbox.title: Replies
inbox.content: Players' messages to NPCs land here. You answer as the NPC.

devices.title: Devices
devices.content: Every device: edit, give, lock, or create more (landline, terminal, pager…).

network.title: Network
network.content: Cut the network for the whole table. Messages wait until it is back. The ? button reopens the welcome window.

Features.Title: Advanced features
Features.Hint: Once you can handle simple phone calls. Not before.
Features.intelHint: Wiretaps on messages between PCs, call list and tracking.
Features.secureHint: Encrypted calls and messages between secure devices, secure lines with NPCs.
Features.jammerHint: A carried device that cuts the network in its scene.
Features.satelliteHint: Satellite option for phones and laptops (Modern, Cyberpunk).

Guide.Title: Getting started
Guide.Open: Ctrl+Shift+P or the floating button opens your device.
Guide.Menu: Menu: the ☰ button. Contacts, about this phone, switch off. Switch on: side button or green key.
Guide.Call: Call: type a number or a name, then the phone button. Any number works, even a made-up one.
Guide.Text: Text: open a conversation, or start a new one with any number.
Guide.Show: Show your screen to the other PCs in the same scene, or forward a message.
Guide.Next: Nothing ever goes to the chat: everything stays on your devices.

SPT.DeleteEntryConfirm: Delete it permanently? It cannot be undone.

News.Title: What's new in Phones & Computers {version}
News.Lines:
## 1.5
**Satellite com** option for devices.
**Devices tab**: favorites (★) to send as an NPC or a place, public devices that other PCs find by name, filters by holder, a legend.
**Directory**: NPC numbers only; text editing becomes Import / export.
**Public option** when creating or editing a device.
New **Brick phone** (1980-90s, calls only) for the Vintage universe.
Universe chosen in the GM welcome window; changing it no longer changes existing devices.
Intel tab (wiretaps, calls, tracking) becomes an advanced feature.
Foundry v13 supported again.
Lots of UX improvements and fixes.
## 1.4
**GM panel big redesign**: setting options, new directory, messages…
Team option: PCs know each other (numbers/emails shared in devices).
Lots of fixes and UI improvements.
